stem.text: The graph shows the variation with time of the velocity of a car.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity /m s-1 against time /s. Velocity axis marked 0, 6 and 12; time axis marked 0 to 10.

A.text: The car accelerates for $2\,\text{s}$, then stops for $4\,\text{s}$ and then reverses.

B.text: The car accelerates at $12\,\text{m s}^{-2}$ for $2\,\text{s}$.

C.text: The car travels a distance of $36\,\text{m}$ in the first $4\,\text{s}$.

D.text: The car travels a distance of $48\,\text{m}$ in the last $4\,\text{s}$.
